name: Second Chance: The Game
source:
Far over the vast blue ocean rises a small, quiet, unremarkable city.
One fine evening, Leslie finds herself at the station of this city, completely losing memories of her past. On the platform, the mysterious girl Neny Ryn meets him, informing him that he is an exchange student at a local university.
In an effort to find out who he was before, Lesley meets many interesting personalities. Many of them share Leslie’s desire to learn more about himself, and some even become his friends. However, the strangeness that Leslie encounters in the very first days of his stay in the city makes him doubt not only whether they are friends, but even the nature of his own mind.
Who are they really? Which of them is lying, and who is telling the truth? And is it true that everyone in our world is entitled to a second chance?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/958720/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
广阔的蔚蓝海洋彼岸，有一座宁静、平凡的小城。
一个晴朗的傍晚，莱斯利发现自己身处这座城市的车站，关于过去的记忆却已荡然无存。月台上，神秘少女Neny Ryn前来相迎，告知莱斯利在当地一所大学就读，是一名交换生。
为了查明过去的自己究竟是谁，莱斯利结识了许多有趣的人。他们之中，不少人也希望帮助莱斯利了解自己的过去，有些甚至成为了朋友。然而，来到这座城市后的头几天，接连发生的怪事让莱斯利开始怀疑：他们真的是朋友吗？就连自己的精神状态是否正常，也变得无法确定。
这些人究竟是谁？谁在说谎，谁在说真话？在这个世界上，每个人真的都有获得第二次机会的资格吗？

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/958720/]Steam[/url]）
